## Unparented

### Generalise the advisor packet into an agent-to-agent context transport

`proposed` · `@akr.work.handoff-context-transport/1`

Make moving work between agents one mechanism rather than three. The advisor packet of the previous wave was a special case wearing the name of the general thing: an advisor, a scout, a worker and a reviewer differ in exactly one respect, how much of the parent's judgement the child may see, and that is a field rather than a subsystem. Delivered as three inherited levels resolved by reference (a derived project capsule, a session capsule holding the user's request verbatim, and packets in four modes), results filed as packets, a coverage roll-up so the next wave is delegated against evidence rather than a hunch, fourteen knowledge.handoff_* MCP tools, and an akr start notice that sends a child to its packet instead of re-deriving the project.

### Give the agent scratch directory a lifecycle

`proposed` · `@akr.work.scratch-lifecycle/1`

Give `.agent/scratch/` a lifecycle, so the one disposable directory nothing empties
on its own stops growing until a person clears it by hand.

Measurement and reporting, not deletion by default: `akr check` prints what is there
as a build fact, `knowledge.start` says the same at orientation, and
`akr check --scratch-clean` is the opt-in gate. `akr scratch prune` removes unkept
entries by age and `akr scratch keep` protects one with a reason, so an agent can
tidy up at the end of a session without being able to delete what the next session
was told to expect. See D-036.
